_description: Living log of in-progress tasks, architectural decisions, known bugs, and ongoing migrations. Updated via the log-task tool.

decisions.title: Landlord onboarding nudge: daily cron + 24h non-overlapping window
decisions.description: Added a once-daily Vercel Cron (15:00 UTC) hitting /api/cron/landlord-nudge that emails landlords who signed up in the last 24h but have no listings. Chose an exact 24h lookback with no dedup column: a fixed daily run + 24h window tiles signups into non-overlapping windows, so each landlord is caught exactly once (no schema change needed). Accepted edge case: a fully failed run skips that day's cohort. Email copy is the warm 'Having trouble?' variant with reply-to info@useproximity.org as a support channel.
decisions.context: PR #59 into staging (feat/landlord-nudge-email). Files: vercel.json, src/app/api/cron/landlord-nudge/route.js, src/lib/email.js (sendLandlordNudgeEmail). Requires CRON_SECRET env var set in Vercel before it runs in prod.

decisions.title: Matchmaking algorithm: budget-window + priority-met-at-budget headline + saturation spread
decisions.description: How the proxy-chat matchmaking system works (feat/proxy-chat). PIPELINE: (1) Fixed deterministic question script (questionScript.js QUESTION_PLAN) -> answers become numeric `weights` over 9 dims via WEIGHT_MAP/PRIORITY_WEIGHTS + RANK_BUMPS (steep [1.0,0.5,0.3...] so #1 priority dominates). recomputeFromPreferences (questionEngine.js) re-derives weights identically from a completed prefs object. (2) chatOrchestrator.computeRecommendations -> listingFilter.rankListings. (3) rankListings: buildRankContext builds a DIVERSE pool (spanning price/reviews/proximity/amenities) and computes a deterministic per-listing fit score (computeFitScores) over data dims; Haiku (claude-haiku-4-5, PROXY_CHAT_KEY) ranks lower slots. THE TOP 3 ARE DETERMINISTIC (selectTopThree), not LLM: #1 = the most-EXPENSIVE IN-BUDGET listing that satisfies the student's #1 stated priority (we give them what they asked for at their budget, not what's 'objectively best'); #2/#3 = spinoffs on the SAME priority each leading a different plus (value/amenities/reviews/proximity). KEY POLICIES: budget is a hard WINDOW, not a cheaper-is-better gradient (the `budget` weight dim is excluded from fit; within budget all prices are equal). 'value' = bang-for-buck (quality per $), not absolute cheapness. Proximity is split into campus/med_campus/grocery via proximity_targets (med-year auto-seeds med_campus; free text parsed by REFINE_SYSTEM). Blank listing titles fall back to street address. SATURATION (new): fetchSaturation reads the live DB demand signal (user_listing_interactions 'contacted' = weight 2, prior matchmaking_chat_sessions.recommendations = weight 1) and uses it as a TIE-BREAKER ONLY among near-equal candidates in selectTopThree, so oversubscribed listings get edged out and demand spreads (never overrides priority or busts budget).
decisions.context: Files: src/lib/matchmaking/{listingFilter,questionEngine,chatOrchestrator,questionScript}.js, listing-filter.skill.md. Test harnesses (dev-only, reusable): /api/dev/matchmaking-probe + scripts/matchmaking-probe.mjs (bias/concentration); /api/dev/matchmaking-saturation-sim + scripts/matchmaking-saturation-sim.mjs (control vs saturation spread, in-memory). Sim result (150 students): distinct #1 picks 18->30, busiest-listing share 28%->15%, HHI 0.128->0.069, with a FLAT timeline (no penalty to early users). Open follow-ups: optional saturation decay window so filled listings aren't penalized forever; ability to turn saturation strength up past tie-break-only. Not yet pushed; branch feat/proxy-chat.

decisions.title: MCP knowledge is committed to git (shared across machines and agents)
decisions.description: mcp/knowledge/ is no longer gitignored (except agent-sessions.json, a machine-local runtime log). Every clone now ships the same repo knowledge, so any contributor's coding agent understands the repo and others' changes without running the MCP first. generate-knowledge.mjs is idempotent (skips rewrites when only the _generated timestamp would change), so regeneration is diff-clean. A CI workflow (.github/workflows/update-knowledge.yml) regenerates and auto-commits drift after pushes to staging/main that touch apps/web/src — this covers contributors who never run the MCP locally. Convention: regenerate and commit knowledge together with code changes; db-schema.json remains hand-maintained against the live DB.
decisions.context: Branch feat/shared-mcp-knowledge; also updated CLAUDE.md, .gitignore, release-pr-check.yml comment, and domain.json workflow.knowledgeMaintenance text.

decisions.title: Matchmaking excludes subleases by default; sublease ≠ sublease_friendly
decisions.description: Proxy matchmaking now excludes sublease listings by default: applySubleasePref (listingFilter.js) drops any listing whose active unit_leases are ALL sublease rows (priced or not — unpriced sublease posts previously slipped through via the room-data path) unless preferences.exclude_subleases === false, which the chat agent sets only when the student explicitly asks for subleases. New exported predicate isSubleaseListing() is the single source of truth; slimCandidate exposes is_sublease to the ranking model and market catalog, and shownListingsContext exposes isSublease to the chat agent. Key semantics: unit_leases.sublease = the lease IS a sublease; listings.sublease_friendly = subletting is ALLOWED (the agent previously conflated these). Also fixed: tradeoff "No strong preference" chip rendered the raw __unsure__ sentinel in the user's bubble (answerToLabel checked kind before the UNSURE sentinel). Data fix: 6038 Westminster Place's active lease was mislabeled sublease=false — corrected in dev; SAME FIX STILL PENDING IN PROD (one-row UPDATE, awaiting approval).
decisions.context: Branch feat/proxy-chat. Files: apps/web/src/lib/matchmaking/{listingFilter.js,chatOrchestrator.js,questionEngine.js,listing-filter.skill.md}. Verified via scratchpad harness against dev DB: 10 subleases in universe, 0 in default search, all flagged is_sublease=true on opt-in.

decisions.title: Matchmaking: description is primary evidence; re-ranks never repeat shown listings
decisions.description: Two ranking-policy changes on feat/proxy-chat. (1) Listing descriptions are now a heavily-weighted, near-authoritative ranking signal: the listing-filter skill + runtime instruction tell the ranker to boost candidates whose description confirms a stated preference/note, demote on conflicts, rule out hard conflicts, and trust the description over structured fields when they disagree; the excerpt passed to the model widened from 320 to 600 chars. (2) Never-repeat re-ranks: any re-rank after recommendations exist (agent update_search, preference-panel PATCH in route.js, rewound answer edits) folds currently shown listing ids into preferences._setAside first, so refines always return entirely new cards. The old "smart repeats" behavior (preference changes cleared _setAside) is removed. Fallbacks: update_search restores previous cards with an honest note when nothing new fits (distinguishing "seen everything that fits" vs "nothing fits at all" via filterEligible without set-aside); finalizeRecommendations clears _setAside and retries rather than going empty on rewound flows; PATCH rolls back the set-aside when it can't produce fresh picks. update_search tool result now includes previous_top {title, still_best_overall} computed by deterministic fit comparison (buildRankContext over the unrestricted pool) so the agent can truthfully say the old #1 is still the best overall fit.
decisions.context: Files: apps/web/src/lib/matchmaking/{chatOrchestrator.js,listingFilter.js,listing-filter.skill.md}, apps/web/src/app/api/matchmaking/chat/route.js. Verified against dev DB: back-to-back re-rank returned 3/3 new listings, zero overlap; previous_top fit comparison behaves honestly.
